title.tr: Antakya Öncesi Amik ve Asi Vadisi Bağlamı
title.en: Pre-Antioch Context of the Amuq and Orontes Valley
title.ar: السياق الإقليمي قبل تأسيس أنطاكية في سهل العمق ووادي العاصي

summary.tr: Antakya'nın Seleukoslar tarafından kurulmasından önce Amik Ovası ve Asi vadisi çok daha eski yerleşim ve ulaşım ağlarına sahipti. Bu dönem modern Antakya kentinin tarihiyle aynı şey değildir; kentin kuruluşunun bölgesel arka planıdır.
summary.en: Before the Seleucid foundation of Antioch, the Amuq Plain and Orontes valley already contained older settlement and communication networks. This is regional background rather than the history of the city itself.
summary.ar: قبل تأسيس أنطاكية السلوقية كانت منطقة العمق ووادي العاصي تضم شبكات استيطان أقدم، وهي خلفية إقليمية وليست تاريخ المدينة نفسها.

urbanChanges: Antioch had not yet been founded as the Seleucid metropolis.
populationCommunityChanges: Earlier regional populations must not be retroactively labeled as citizens of Antioch.
importantStructures: Earlier regional archaeological sites are separate place entities.
editorialNotes: Do not extend the history of the city of Antioch backward to every earlier settlement in the region.
unresolvedQuestions: Detailed pre-Seleucid regional chronology requires a dedicated archaeological research pass.

summary.tr: Antioch, Seleukos I Nikator döneminde MÖ 4. yüzyılın sonu ile MÖ 3. yüzyılın başlangıcı arasındaki Seleukos kent kurma programı içinde kuruldu. Araştırmada geleneksel tarih yaklaşık MÖ 300 olarak ele alındı.
summary.en: Antioch was founded under Seleucus I Nicator as part of the early Seleucid urban program, traditionally dated to around 300 BCE.
summary.ar: تأسست أنطاكية في عهد سلوقس الأول نيكاتور ضمن مشروع تأسيس المدن السلوقية، ويؤرخ تأسيسها تقليدياً بنحو 300 ق.م.

urbanChanges: Establishment of a new Seleucid city on the Orontes.
Development of a planned Hellenistic urban center.
Later expansion created a larger metropolitan settlement.
populationCommunityChanges: Seleucid/Macedonian-Greek settlement formed part of the early civic population.
Local regional populations must not be erased from the broader urban history.
religiousCulturalChanges: Hellenistic civic and religious institutions developed.
editorialNotes: Use c. 300 BCE rather than presenting a disputed exact foundation day as certain.
unresolvedQuestions: Foundation-date variants such as 301/300 BCE should be retained in specialist notes if later verified.

summary.tr: Antioch Seleukos Krallığı'nın başlıca kentlerinden biri olarak gelişti. Asi vadisi, Akdeniz liman bağlantısı ve Daphne ile ilişkisi kentin siyasal, ticari ve kültürel önemini artırdı.
summary.en: Antioch developed into one of the major cities of the Seleucid kingdom, strengthened by its position in the Orontes valley, access toward the Mediterranean and its relationship with Daphne.
summary.ar: تطورت أنطاكية إلى واحدة من أبرز مدن الدولة السلوقية، وأسهم موقعها في وادي العاصي وعلاقتها بدافني وبطرق المتوسط في أهميتها.

urbanChanges: Expansion of the Hellenistic metropolis.
Development of Daphne as a major suburban cultural and sacred landscape.
Connections to Seleucia Pieria strengthened the regional urban system.
populationCommunityChanges: Hellenistic urban population was multi-origin; modern national identities must not be retrojected.
religiousCulturalChanges: Greco-Roman/Hellenistic religious traditions became prominent in civic life.
unresolvedQuestions: Precise demographic figures from ancient literary traditions should not be treated as modern census data.

title.tr: Roma Yönetimi ve Eyalet Başkenti Antioch

summary.tr: Pompeius'un Suriye'yi Roma yönetimine katmasıyla Antioch Roma doğusunun önde gelen eyalet merkezlerinden biri oldu. Kent Roma İmparatorluğu döneminde idari, askerî ve ticari önemini büyüttü.
summary.en: Following Rome's annexation of Syria under Pompey, Antioch became one of the principal provincial centers of the Roman East.
summary.ar: بعد ضم سوريا إلى الحكم الروماني في عهد بومبي أصبحت أنطاكية من أهم مراكز الولايات في الشرق الروماني.

urbanChanges: Major Roman civic and infrastructure investment.
Expansion of streets, baths, residences and entertainment/public architecture.
populationCommunityChanges: Large and diverse metropolitan population.
Jewish community forms an important historical component.
Modern ethnic categories should not be projected onto Roman inhabitants.
religiousCulturalChanges: Greco-Roman religious institutions remained important.
Jewish and later Christian communities formed part of the city's religious landscape.
unresolvedQuestions: Ancient population estimates remain methodologically disputed.

summary.tr: Antioch erken Hristiyanlık tarihinin başlıca merkezlerinden biri oldu. Kentte erken cemaat, piskoposluk/patriklik gelenekleri ve farklı teolojik çizgiler gelişti. Yeni Ahit ve kilise geleneğindeki bazı anlatılar tarihsel kanıtla aynı kategoriye konulmamalıdır.
summary.en: Antioch became one of the principal centers of early Christianity. Early communities, episcopal traditions and major theological currents developed there, while scriptural and ecclesiastical traditions must remain distinct from independently verified history.
summary.ar: أصبحت أنطاكية من أهم مراكز المسيحية المبكرة، مع تطور الجماعات والمؤسسات الكنسية والتيارات اللاهوتية فيها. ويجب الفصل بين الرواية الدينية والدليل التاريخي المستقل.

urbanChanges: Christian worship and community networks became part of the metropolitan landscape.
populationCommunityChanges: Christian communities grew within an already religiously diverse city.
religiousCulturalChanges: Development of important Christian institutions and traditions.
Emergence of Antiochene theological and ecclesiastical significance.
importantStructures: St. Pierre Cave Church as later sacred-site tradition; exact apostolic use is not archaeologically proven.
editorialNotes: Claims about specific apostles using specific surviving structures must be marked religiousTradition unless independently demonstrated.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact chronology of individual early worship places remains complex.

summary.tr: Dördüncü ile altıncı yüzyıllar arasında Antioch Roma/Doğu Roma dünyasının büyük kentlerinden biri olarak önemini korudu; ancak yangınlar, depremler, dinî-siyasal çatışmalar ve savaşlar kent dokusunu tekrar tekrar değiştirdi.
summary.en: From the fourth through sixth centuries Antioch remained a major city of the Roman/Eastern Roman world, while earthquakes, fires, wars and religious-political conflict repeatedly altered its urban fabric.
summary.ar: حافظت أنطاكية بين القرنين الرابع والسادس على مكانتها كمدينة كبرى، لكن الزلازل والحرائق والحروب والصراعات غيرت عمرانها مراراً.

urbanChanges: Repeated rebuilding after major disasters.
Christian sacred architecture became increasingly prominent.
Water and defensive infrastructure remained important.
populationCommunityChanges: Christian population and institutions became increasingly prominent.
Jewish and other groups continued to form part of the complex urban history.
religiousCulturalChanges: Christianization of civic landscape.
Complex theological and ecclesiastical divisions.
importantStructures: Demirkapı/Bab el-Hadid system in its later antique form

summary.tr: 526 depremi Geç Antik Antioch'un en yıkıcı afetlerinden biri olarak tarihsel kaynaklarda yer alır ve kent dokusunun yeniden inşasında önemli bir kırılma oluşturur.
summary.en: The earthquake of 526 was one of the major disasters of late-antique Antioch and became a major rupture in the city's built environment.
summary.ar: كان زلزال سنة 526 من أكبر كوارث أنطاكية في العصور القديمة المتأخرة وأدى إلى تحول مهم في عمران المدينة.

urbanChanges: Major destruction and subsequent rebuilding.
populationCommunityChanges: Large-scale human loss is reported by historical sources, but exact figures should be treated cautiously.
religiousCulturalChanges: Disaster became part of Antioch's long-term historical memory.
editorialNotes: Ancient casualty figures may be rhetorical and should not be treated as modern statistical counts.

title.tr: 540 Sasani Saldırısı ve Justinianus Dönemi Yeniden İnşa
title.en: The Sasanian Sack of 540 and Justinianic Reconstruction
title.ar: الهجوم الساساني سنة 540 وإعادة الإعمار في عهد جستنيان

summary.tr: I. Hüsrev'in 540 seferi sırasında Antioch ağır biçimde tahrip edildi. Sonraki Doğu Roma/Justinianus müdahaleleri kent savunması ve altyapısı üzerinde yeni evreler oluşturdu.
summary.en: Antioch suffered severe destruction during Khosrow I's campaign in 540, followed by major Eastern Roman/Justinianic reconstruction and defensive interventions.
summary.ar: تعرضت أنطاكية لدمار شديد خلال حملة كسرى الأول سنة 540، ثم شهدت أعمال إعادة بناء وتحصين في العصر الجستنياني.

urbanChanges: Destruction of major areas.
Rebuilding and strengthening of defensive and hydraulic systems.
populationCommunityChanges: War and forced movement affected the urban population.
unresolvedQuestions: Individual surviving structures should not automatically be assigned wholly to 540s reconstruction without architectural evidence.

title.en: Seventh-Century Wars and the Islamic Conquest

summary.tr: Bizans-Sasani savaşlarının ardından Antioch 630'ların sonlarında Müslüman yönetimine geçti. Araştırmada fetih yaklaşık 637/638 çevresinde ele alındı.
summary.en: Following the Byzantine-Sasanian wars, Antioch passed under Muslim rule in the late 630s, conventionally placed around 637/638.
summary.ar: بعد الحروب البيزنطية الساسانية انتقلت أنطاكية إلى الحكم الإسلامي في أواخر ثلاثينيات القرن السابع، نحو 637/638.

urbanChanges: Administrative and military orientation shifted within the early Islamic polity.
populationCommunityChanges: Political transition did not imply instantaneous replacement of the existing population.
Christian communities continued under new political rule.
religiousCulturalChanges: Islamic institutions gradually became part of the city's landscape.
Existing Christian communities and traditions continued.
importantStructures: Early mosque traditions require structure-level source distinction.
editorialNotes: Do not equate the conquest date with the construction date of every later mosque.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact conquest-year variants should remain open where sources differ.

summary.tr: Antakya Emevî döneminde Suriye ve Bizans sınır dünyasının parçasıydı. Kentin eski imparatorluk metropolü niteliği dönüşürken bölgesel askerî ve idari rolü devam etti.
summary.en: Under the Umayyads, Antioch formed part of the Syrian and Byzantine-frontier world, with its metropolitan role transformed but continuing regional significance.
summary.ar: كانت أنطاكية في العصر الأموي جزءاً من المجال السوري والحدودي مع البيزنطيين، مع تحول دورها الحضري واستمرار أهميتها الإقليمية.

religiousCulturalChanges: Muslim and Christian communities formed part of the city's developing medieval religious landscape.

title.ar: أنطاكية في العصر العباسي وإدارات الثغور

summary.tr: Abbasi döneminde Antakya Bizans sınırına yakın askerî ve bölgesel ağların içinde yer aldı. Yönetim ve nüfuz çeşitli dönemlerde bölgesel aktörler arasında değişebildi.
summary.en: Under the Abbasids Antioch belonged to the military and regional networks of the Byzantine frontier, with political control and influence changing at different moments.
summary.ar: كانت أنطاكية في العصر العباسي ضمن شبكات الثغور القريبة من المجال البيزنطي، وتغيرت أنماط السيطرة والنفوذ عبر الفترات.

editorialNotes: Do not reduce the whole 750–969 period to uninterrupted direct central Abbasid administration.
unresolvedQuestions: Sub-period political control requires a specialist medieval chronology.

title.tr: Bizans'ın Yeniden Hâkimiyeti ve 11. Yüzyıl Geçişleri
title.ar: استعادة الحكم البيزنطي وتحولات القرن الحادي عشر

summary.tr: Bizans kuvvetleri 969'da Antioch'u yeniden ele geçirdi. On birinci yüzyılda ise Bizans, bölgesel Türk/Selçuklu güçleri ve başka aktörler arasında denetim değişimleri yaşandı; bu nedenle 969–1098 dönemi tek bir kesintisiz yönetim olarak modellenmemelidir.
summary.en: Byzantine forces recaptured Antioch in 969. During the eleventh century, control shifted among Byzantines, Turkish/Seljuk forces and other regional actors, so 969–1098 should not be modeled as one uninterrupted regime.
summary.ar: استعاد البيزنطيون أنطاكية سنة 969، ثم شهد القرن الحادي عشر تغيرات في السيطرة بين البيزنطيين وقوى تركية/سلجوقية وغيرها.

urbanChanges: Renewed Byzantine military and ecclesiastical importance.
populationCommunityChanges: Medieval population included multiple linguistic and confessional groups.
religiousCulturalChanges: Christian ecclesiastical institutions regained imperial support.
unresolvedQuestions: Detailed control chronology between 1080s and 1098 remains intentionally simplified.

summary.tr: 1098'de Haçlıların kenti ele geçirmesiyle Antakya Prensliği kuruldu. Bu dönem Latin, Rum, Ermeni, Süryani ve diğer bölgesel toplulukların karmaşık ilişkileriyle karakterizedir.
summary.en: The capture of Antioch by Crusader forces in 1098 led to the creation of the Principality of Antioch, a politically and confessionally complex society involving Latin, Greek, Armenian, Syriac and other populations.
summary.ar: أدى استيلاء الصليبيين على أنطاكية سنة 1098 إلى قيام إمارة أنطاكية، ضمن مجتمع متعدد الجماعات الكنسية واللغوية.

urbanChanges: Reuse and alteration of earlier urban and defensive fabric.
Latin ecclesiastical institutions became politically dominant.
populationCommunityChanges: Complex Latin, Greek, Armenian, Syriac and local populations.
religiousCulturalChanges: Latin ecclesiastical authority existed alongside older eastern Christian communities.
editorialNotes: Do not treat all medieval Christian remains as Crusader constructions without structural evidence.

summary.tr: Memlükler 1268'de Antakya Prensliği'ne son verdi. Kent sonraki yüzyıllarda eski Geç Antik/Haçlı metropol ölçeğinden farklı, bölgesel bir yerleşim olarak gelişti.
summary.en: The Mamluk conquest of 1268 ended the Principality of Antioch. Thereafter the settlement developed at a different scale from the great late-antique and Crusader metropolis.
summary.ar: أنهى الفتح المملوكي سنة 1268 إمارة أنطاكية، وتطورت المدينة لاحقاً على نطاق حضري مختلف عن مراحلها السابقة.

urbanChanges: Major shift in political and urban scale.
religiousCulturalChanges: Islamic institutions formed a major part of the medieval urban landscape.
importantStructures: Antakya Ulucamii includes medieval/Mamluk-period evidence but has multiple later phases.

summary.tr: Antakya 1516 sonrasında Osmanlı idari ve ekonomik sistemine dahil oldu. Mahalleler, camiler, vakıflar, çarşılar, zanaatlar ve kırsal nahiye ağları kentin Osmanlı dönemi yapısını şekillendirdi.
summary.en: After 1516 Antakya became part of the Ottoman administrative and economic system. Neighborhoods, mosques, waqfs, markets, crafts and rural district networks shaped the Ottoman town.
summary.ar: دخلت أنطاكية في النظام الإداري والاقتصادي العثماني بعد سنة 1516، وتشكل نسيجها من الأحياء والأوقاف والأسواق والحرف وشبكات القرى.

urbanChanges: Development and reorganization of Ottoman neighborhoods.
Expansion of mosque, waqf, market and residential networks.
populationCommunityChanges: Multiple Muslim and Christian communities were present.
Community distributions changed over time and should not be mapped statically.
religiousCulturalChanges: Mosque, waqf, church and local sacred-site traditions contributed to the urban landscape.
editorialNotes: Historical neighborhood names must not automatically be equated with modern administrative boundaries.

title.tr: 19. ve Erken 20. Yüzyılda Antakya ve Hatay
title.en: Antakya and Hatay in the Nineteenth and Early Twentieth Centuries
title.ar: أنطاكية وهاتاي في القرن التاسع عشر وبدايات القرن العشرين

summary.tr: 19. yüzyılda reformlar, bölgesel ticaret, konsolosluk ve misyoner faaliyetleri, ipek ekonomisi, yeni cemaat kurumları ve ulaştırma ağları Antakya ile İskenderun çevresini dönüştürdü.
summary.en: During the nineteenth century reforms, regional trade, consular and missionary activity, the silk economy, communal institutions and transport networks transformed Antakya and the Alexandretta region.
summary.ar: شهد القرن التاسع عشر تحولات مرتبطة بالإصلاحات والتجارة والقنصليات والنشاط التبشيري واقتصاد الحرير وشبكات النقل.

urbanChanges: Modernization of urban institutions.
Growth of İskenderun as a port city.
Continued traditional residential and bazaar fabric in Antakya.
populationCommunityChanges: Migration and commercial mobility reshaped communities.
Christian and Jewish institutions remained visible in the urban landscape.
religiousCulturalChanges: Church, school and communal institutional development.
Continued Muslim religious and waqf institutions.
importantStructures: late Ottoman civic and commercial buildings
unresolvedQuestions: Fine-grained demographic statistics require source-by-source normalization.

title.tr: I. Dünya Savaşı ve Osmanlı Sonrası Geçiş
title.en: World War I and the Post-Ottoman Transition
title.ar: الحرب العالمية الأولى والانتقال بعد العهد العثماني

summary.tr: I. Dünya Savaşı sonrasında Osmanlı idaresinin sona ermesi Hatay ve İskenderun Sancağı'nda yeni sınırlar, yönetimler ve topluluk hareketleri yarattı. Ermeni nüfusun savaş dönemi deneyimleri, Musa Dağı ve daha geniş bölgesel zorunlu göç tarihi ayrı ve dikkatli biçimde ele alınmalıdır.
summary.en: The end of Ottoman rule after World War I introduced new borders, administrations and population movements in the Sanjak of Alexandretta. Armenian wartime experiences, Musa Dagh and wider forced-migration histories require dedicated, source-sensitive treatment.
summary.ar: أدى انتهاء الحكم العثماني بعد الحرب العالمية الأولى إلى حدود وإدارات وتحركات سكانية جديدة في لواء إسكندرون، مع ضرورة معالجة تاريخ التهجير والأحداث الأرمنية بمصادر متخصصة.

populationCommunityChanges: War, deportation, displacement, return and migration affected multiple communities.
editorialNotes: 1915 and Musa Dagh require established scholarship and non-denialist terminology.
Antakya city, Musa Dagh and the wider sanjak must remain geographically distinct.

title.en: French Mandate and the Sanjak of Alexandretta

summary.tr: Antakya ve çevresi Fransız Mandası döneminde İskenderun Sancağı bağlamında yeni idari, eğitimsel, ekonomik ve dilsel etkiler yaşadı. Bu dönem aile hafızalarında farklı ve kimi zaman karşıt biçimlerde hatırlanmaktadır.
summary.en: During the French Mandate, Antakya and the surrounding region formed part of the Sanjak of Alexandretta and underwent administrative, educational, economic and linguistic change. Family memories of this period are diverse and sometimes contradictory.
summary.ar: شهدت أنطاكية والمنطقة في عهد الانتداب الفرنسي تغيرات إدارية وتعليمية واقتصادية ولغوية ضمن لواء الإسكندرون، وتختلف ذكريات العائلات حول هذه المرحلة.

urbanChanges: New planning and institutional influences.
İskenderun expanded as a port city.
populationCommunityChanges: Migration and political uncertainty affected community composition.
Families could be divided by emerging political boundaries.
religiousCulturalChanges: Community schools and institutions remained important.
editorialNotes: Oral memory of the Mandate must not be converted automatically into verified historical fact.

title.en: The Hatay State and Incorporation into Turkey

summary.tr: Hatay Devleti 1938–1939 arasında kısa süreli bir siyasi yapı olarak var oldu; 1939'da bölge Türkiye'ye katıldı. Süreç Türk, Suriye, Ermeni, Arap, Rum Ortodoks ve başka topluluk hafızalarında farklı biçimlerde değerlendirilebilir.
summary.en: The Hatay State existed briefly in 1938–1939, followed by the incorporation of the territory into Turkey in 1939. The process is remembered differently across national and community historiographies.
summary.ar: وجدت دولة هاتاي لفترة قصيرة بين 1938 و1939، ثم انضمت المنطقة إلى تركيا سنة 1939. وتختلف الذاكرة والتأريخ حول هذه المرحلة بين الجماعات والسرديات الوطنية.

populationCommunityChanges: Migration and community departures followed political change.
Musa Dagh Armenian migration forms a major community-specific consequence.
Cross-border family networks were affected.
editorialNotes: Use neutral chronological language; avoid nationalist advocacy.
Different historiographical perspectives should be preserved where relevant.
unresolvedQuestions: Community-specific migration figures require dedicated demographic normalization.

title.en: Antakya after 1939 and the Recent Period

summary.tr: 1939 sonrasında Antakya Türkiye Cumhuriyeti'nin idari yapısı içinde gelişti. Kentleşme, kırsal-kentsel göç, uluslararası göç, dil değişimi, cemaat küçülmeleri ve yeni yerleşim örüntüleri kültürel dokuyu dönüştürdü.
summary.en: After 1939 Antakya developed within the Republic of Turkey. Urbanization, rural-urban and international migration, language shift, changing community sizes and new settlement patterns transformed the region.
summary.ar: تطورت أنطاكية بعد 1939 ضمن الجمهورية التركية، وتأثرت بالتوسع الحضري والهجرة والتحولات اللغوية وتغير أحجام الجماعات.

urbanChanges: Modern expansion beyond the historic core.
Administrative restructuring including creation of Defne district in the 2010s.
populationCommunityChanges: Emigration reduced some historic minority communities.
European diaspora networks expanded.
New migrant communities became part of Hatay's social landscape.
religiousCulturalChanges: Continuity and transformation of sacred-site, church, mosque and community practices.
unresolvedQuestions: Fine-grained demographic changes by community remain incompletely normalized.

title.en: The 2023 Earthquakes and the Cultural Heritage of Antakya/Hatay
title.ar: زلزالا 2023 والتراث الثقافي في أنطاكية وهاتاي

summary.tr: 2023 depremleri Antakya ve Hatay'ın tarihî kent dokusunda, ibadet yapılarında, geleneksel evlerinde, çarşılarında ve topluluk kurumlarında büyük kayba yol açtı. Fiziksel yıkıma toplulukların yerinden edilmesi ve yaşayan hafıza kaybı eşlik etti.
summary.en: The 2023 earthquakes caused extensive losses to the historic urban fabric, religious buildings, traditional houses, markets and community institutions of Antakya and Hatay. Physical destruction was accompanied by displacement and loss of living memory.
summary.ar: أدت زلازل 2023 إلى خسائر واسعة في النسيج التاريخي والمباني الدينية والبيوت التقليدية والأسواق والمؤسسات المجتمعية، إضافة إلى النزوح وفقدان جوانب من الذاكرة الحية.

urbanChanges: Large-scale destruction in the historic center.
Emergency stabilization, reconstruction and heritage-recovery programs.
Reconstructed structures must be distinguished from structures that survived.
populationCommunityChanges: Large-scale temporary and long-term displacement.
Community continuity became linked to housing, worship sites and return.
religiousCulturalChanges: Damage to mosques, churches, synagogue and sacred sites affected living religious practice.
Post-disaster memory became a major oral-history theme.
importantStructures: multiple community churches and heritage buildings
editorialNotes: Do not aestheticize disaster or use loss as tourism content.
Restored, reconstructed and surviving must remain distinct conservation states.
unresolvedQuestions: Many building-specific reconstruction statuses continue to change.

summary.tr: Hatay'ın özellikle Samandağ, Defne ve çevresinde güçlü tarihsel ve kültürel varlığı bulunan Arapça konuşan topluluklarından biridir. “Nusayri”, “Arap Alevi” ve “Alawite” adları farklı dönemlerde ve kaynaklarda farklı anlam ve öz-adlandırma yükleri taşıdığından tek bir etikete indirgenmemelidir.
summary.en: One of Hatay's major Arabic-speaking communities, with particularly strong historical and cultural presence around Samandağ and Defne. The terms Nusayri, Arab Alawite and Alawite carry different historical, scholarly and self-identification contexts.
summary.ar: من أبرز الجماعات الناطقة بالعربية في هاتاي، ولا سيما في صمنداغ ودفنه ومحيطهما. وتختلف دلالات تسميات نصيري وعلوي عربي وعلوي بحسب السياق التاريخي والاجتماعي.

label.en: historically documented in the region – present

editorialNotes: COMMUNITY != BELIEF.
Do not use Nusayri, Arab Alawite and Alawite as timeless exact synonyms without source context.
Do not assign every Arabic-speaking Hatay resident to this community.
unresolvedQuestions: Preferred self-designations vary by speaker, generation and context.

summary.tr: Hatay'ın farklı ilçe, köy ve kent alanlarında tarihsel olarak yaşayan Arapça konuşan Sünni topluluklar için kullanılan topluluk kategorisidir. Yerleşim, lehçe ve kültürel pratikler ilçe ve köy düzeyinde ayrı araştırılmalıdır.
summary.en: An umbrella community category for Arabic-speaking Sunni populations historically present in different parts of Hatay. Settlement, dialect and local culture require locality-specific documentation.
summary.ar: تصنيف جامع للسكان العرب السنة في مناطق مختلفة من هاتاي، مع ضرورة توثيق الفروق المحلية في اللهجة والاستيطان والممارسات الثقافية.

label.en: Ottoman to present; earlier continuity requires locality-specific evidence

culturalPractices: shared regional wedding and music traditions where locally documented
editorialNotes: Do not infer Sunni identity from Arabic language alone.
unresolvedQuestions: Village-by-village community distribution requires further structured research.

summary.tr: Arapça konuşan Hristiyan Hatay toplulukları için üst düzey bir community umbrella kaydıdır. Rum Ortodoks, Katolik ve diğer kilise aidiyetleri bu üst kaydın altında otomatik olarak tek topluluk kabul edilmemelidir.
summary.en: An umbrella record for Arabic-speaking Christian communities in Hatay. Greek Orthodox, Catholic and other church affiliations must remain separately identifiable rather than being collapsed into one community.
summary.ar: سجل جامع للجماعات المسيحية الناطقة بالعربية في هاتاي، مع ضرورة الفصل بين الانتماءات الكنسية المختلفة.

editorialNotes: Umbrella entity; not a denomination.
Do not make all Arab Christians Greek Orthodox.
unresolvedQuestions: Denomination-by-locality mapping remains incomplete.

title.tr: Hatay Arapça Konuşan Rum Ortodoks Topluluğu
title.en: Arabic-Speaking Greek Orthodox Community of Hatay
title.ar: طائفة الروم الأرثوذكس الناطقة بالعربية في هاتاي

summary.tr: Antakya ve Hatay'ın tarihsel Hristiyan topluluklarından biridir. “Rum” terimi Osmanlı ve Doğu Akdeniz bağlamında doğrudan modern Yunan milliyetiyle eşitlenmemeli; kilise aidiyeti, dil ve vatandaşlık ayrı alanlarda tutulmalıdır.
summary.en: One of the historic Christian communities of Antakya and Hatay. The term Rum in Ottoman and eastern Mediterranean contexts should not automatically be equated with modern Greek nationality.
summary.ar: من الجماعات المسيحية التاريخية في أنطاكية وهاتاي. ولا ينبغي مساواة مصطلح الروم تلقائياً بالقومية اليونانية الحديثة.

editorialNotes: Rum identity, Arabic language, ecclesiastical affiliation and nationality are distinct data dimensions.
unresolvedQuestions: Local dialect and settlement continuity should be documented place by place.

summary.tr: Musa Dağı ve Süveydiye çevresindeki tarihsel Ermeni köyleri ile günümüzde Vakıflı/Vakıfköy merkezli devam eden topluluk mirasını kapsar. 1915, savaş sonrası geri dönüşler ve 1939 göçü topluluk hafızasının temel tarihsel kırılmalarıdır.
summary.en: The community encompasses the historic Armenian villages of Musa Dagh and Svedia and the continuing heritage centered on Vakıflı/Vakıfköy. The events of 1915, postwar returns and the 1939 migration are major historical ruptures.
summary.ar: يشمل السجل القرى الأرمنية التاريخية في جبل موسى والسويدية واستمرار المجتمع المرتبط بوقفلي، مع محطات رئيسية في 1915 والعودة بعد الحرب وهجرة 1939.

editorialNotes: 1915 must be treated with established scholarship and non-denialist terminology.
Historic village names require careful gazetteer mapping.
unresolvedQuestions: Several historic-to-modern village equivalences remain unresolved.

summary.tr: Antakya'nın antik dönemden modern döneme kadar farklı tarihsel evrelerde belgelenen Yahudi mirasının modern topluluk boyutunu temsil eder. Modern dönemde cemaat küçülmüş, göçler topluluk sürekliliğini önemli ölçüde etkilemiştir.
summary.en: Represents the modern community dimension of the long Jewish heritage documented in Antioch. Migration and demographic decline significantly affected modern community continuity.
summary.ar: يمثل البعد المجتمعي الحديث للتراث اليهودي التاريخي في أنطاكية، وقد أثرت الهجرة وتراجع عدد السكان في استمراريته المعاصرة.

editorialNotes: Ancient Jewish population history and the modern community are related but not identical demographic entities.
unresolvedQuestions: Post-2023 community continuity and local musical traditions require updated research.

title.en: Turkish and Turkmen Communities of Hatay

summary.tr: Hatay'ın Osmanlı ve Cumhuriyet dönemi toplumsal tarihinde Türkçe konuşan ve farklı tarihsel Türkmen/Yörük kökenleri taşıyan topluluklar önemli bir yer tutar. Türk, Türkmen ve Yörük terimleri otomatik olarak birbirinin yerine kullanılmamalıdır.
summary.en: Turkish-speaking and historically Turkmen/Yörük communities form an important part of Hatay's Ottoman and Republican social history. Turkish, Turkmen and Yörük should not be treated as automatic synonyms.
summary.ar: تشكل الجماعات الناطقة بالتركية والجماعات ذات الخلفيات التركمانية واليوروكية جزءاً مهماً من تاريخ هاتاي الحديث، مع ضرورة الفصل بين المصطلحات المختلفة.

editorialNotes: Do not collapse Yörük, Turkmen and Turkish civic identities into one historical category.
unresolvedQuestions: Subcommunity and settlement-level differentiation requires further research.

summary.tr: Hatay'ın bazı yerleşimlerinde tarihsel ve modern Kürt nüfus bulunmaktadır. Bu araştırma turunda topluluğun köy, lehçe, göç ve kültürel pratikleri diğer ana topluluklar kadar ayrıntılı normalleştirilmemiştir.
summary.en: Kurdish populations are historically and presently documented in parts of Hatay, but locality, dialect, migration and cultural-practice data were not normalized in equal depth in this research cycle.
summary.ar: توجد جماعات كردية تاريخية ومعاصرة في أجزاء من هاتاي، لكن تفاصيل الاستيطان واللهجات والممارسات لا تزال بحاجة إلى بحث أعمق.

editorialNotes: Included because historical presence was identified in DR-2; detailed profile remains incomplete.
unresolvedQuestions: Settlement areas, dialects, beliefs and cultural practices need dedicated research.

title.ar: الجماعات السريانية التاريخية في أنطاكية وهاتاي

summary.tr: Antakya'nın geç antik ve ortaçağ Hristiyan tarihi Süryanice konuşan ve Süryani kilise gelenekleriyle bağlantılı grupları içerir. Modern Hatay'daki sürekli topluluk ölçeği bu araştırmada yeterince doğrulanmamıştır.
summary.en: Antioch's late-antique and medieval Christian history includes Syriac-speaking populations and Syriac ecclesiastical traditions. The scale of continuous modern community presence in Hatay remains insufficiently researched here.
summary.ar: يشمل تاريخ أنطاكية المسيحي جماعات ناطقة بالسريانية وتقاليد كنسية سريانية، بينما يحتاج الوجود المجتمعي الحديث في هاتاي إلى توثيق أدق.

label.en: late antique / medieval; modern continuity UNRESOLVED

editorialNotes: Do not infer a large continuous modern community from late-antique ecclesiastical history.
unresolvedQuestions: Modern Hatay Syriac community continuity requires dedicated verification.

summary.tr: Antakya'da 19. yüzyıl ve sonrasında Kapuçin/Latin Katolik kurumsal varlığıyla bağlantılı topluluk kaydıdır. Katolik belief kaydı ve Latin Katolik Kilisesi structure kaydından ayrı tutulur.
summary.en: Community record associated with the Latin Catholic/Capuchin presence in Antakya from the nineteenth century onward. It remains separate from the Catholic belief and the church structure.
summary.ar: سجل للجماعة المرتبطة بالحضور الكاثوليكي اللاتيني/الكبوشي في أنطاكية منذ القرن التاسع عشر.

unresolvedQuestions: Historical membership and language profile require deeper research.

summary.tr: 19. ve 20. yüzyıl misyonerlik, okul ve cemaat tarihleri bağlamında Protestan varlığı araştırmaya dahil edilmiştir; ancak denomination, yerleşim ve topluluk sürekliliği bu araştırmada yeterince ayrıntılı doğrulanmamıştır.
summary.en: Protestant presence was identified in the context of nineteenth- and twentieth-century mission, school and community histories, but denomination-level continuity and locality require further research.
summary.ar: تم رصد وجود بروتستانتي ضمن تاريخ الإرساليات والمدارس، لكن تفاصيل الطوائف والاستمرارية المحلية تحتاج إلى توثيق إضافي.

unresolvedQuestions: Denominations, institutions, settlement areas and continuity require dedicated research.

summary.tr: Antakya'da özellikle profesyonel müzisyenlik ağı üzerinden saha araştırmasıyla belgelenmiş Dom topluluğudur. Dom kimliği tek bir müzik türüyle eşitlenmemeli; araştırılan müzisyenler çok dilli ve çok repertuvarlı profesyonel icracılardır.
summary.en: A Dom community in Antakya documented especially through fieldwork on professional musicians. Dom identity should not be equated with a single genre; documented musicians perform multilingual and diverse repertoires.
summary.ar: مجتمع الدوم في أنطاكية موثق خصوصاً من خلال دراسات الموسيقيين المحترفين، ولا ينبغي اختزاله في نوع موسيقي واحد.

editorialNotes: Community != performer profession.
unresolvedQuestions: Broader community history beyond the musician sample requires further research.

summary.tr: Reyhanlı çevresindeki Çerkes toplulukları göç, aile hafızası, geçiş ritüelleri, yemek, anlatı ve kalıp sözler üzerinden halkbilimi saha çalışmalarıyla belgelenmiştir.
summary.en: Circassian communities around Reyhanlı have been documented through fieldwork on migration memory, family life, rituals, food and oral culture.
summary.ar: وُثقت الجماعات الشركسية في منطقة الريحانية من خلال دراسات ميدانية عن الهجرة والذاكرة والعادات والثقافة الشفوية.

unresolvedQuestions: Specific Circassian subgroup/language mapping remains incomplete.

summary.tr: Kırıkhan çevresindeki Yörük toplulukları konargöçerlik, hayvancılık, kıl çadır, geçiş ritüelleri, ağıt, atasözü ve anlatılar üzerinden halkbilimi saha araştırmasıyla belgelenmiştir.
summary.en: Yörük communities around Kırıkhan have been documented through fieldwork on pastoral mobility, tents, livestock, lifecycle rituals, laments and oral culture.

editorialNotes: Yörük should not automatically be merged into every Turkmen/Turkish community record.
unresolvedQuestions: Historical migration routes require further place-level mapping.

summary.tr: 1982'de Afganistan'dan Türkiye'ye yerleştirilen Özbek ailelerin Ovakent'teki topluluk hafızası, özellikle kadınların koşukları ve gurbet anlatıları üzerinden saha araştırmasıyla belgelenmiştir.
summary.en: Uzbek families resettled from Afghanistan in 1982 formed a community in Ovakent whose memory has been documented especially through women's koshuk songs and migration narratives.
summary.ar: استقرت عائلات أوزبكية قادمة من أفغانستان في أوفاكنت سنة 1982، ووثقت الذاكرة المجتمعية خصوصاً من خلال أغاني النساء وروايات الغربة.

editorialNotes: Community was identified during DR-7 and should be added to the broader community inventory.
unresolvedQuestions: Belief affiliations and wider community history were not part of the music-focused source.

title.en: Historical Population Groups of Hellenistic Antioch

summary.tr: Seleukos dönemi Antioch'un Makedon/Yunan yerleşimci gruplarını ve yerel bölgesel nüfusları içeren tarihsel nüfus bağlamını temsil eden analitik bir entity'dir; modern etnik topluluk gibi kullanılmamalıdır.
summary.en: Analytical entity for the mixed historical population context of Seleucid Antioch, including Macedonian/Greek settlers and local regional populations. It is not a modern ethnic community.
summary.ar: كيان تحليلي لسكان أنطاكية السلوقية التاريخيين، ولا يمثل جماعة إثنية حديثة.

editorialNotes: Do not assign modern Greek nationality to all Hellenistic inhabitants.
unresolvedQuestions: Detailed demographic composition is historically uncertain.

title.tr: Roma ve Bizans Antioch Tarihsel Nüfus Grupları
title.en: Historical Population Groups of Roman and Byzantine Antioch
title.ar: المجموعات السكانية في أنطاكية الرومانية والبيزنطية

summary.tr: Roma ve Geç Antik Antioch'un farklı dil, din ve toplumsal statülerdeki sakinlerini modern ulus kategorilerine zorlamadan temsil etmek için oluşturulmuş tarihsel-popülasyon entity'sidir.
summary.en: Historical-population entity designed to represent the linguistically, religiously and socially diverse inhabitants of Roman and Byzantine Antioch without forcing them into modern national categories.
summary.ar: كيان تاريخي يمثل تنوع سكان أنطاكية الرومانية والبيزنطية دون إسقاط التصنيفات القومية الحديثة عليهم.

editorialNotes: Not a modern ethnic community.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact population proportions are uncertain and ancient numerical claims should be treated cautiously.

summary.tr: Hatay'daki Arap Alevi topluluğuyla güçlü biçimde ilişkili, tarihsel olarak Nusayri/Alawi adlandırmalarıyla da incelenmiş inanç geleneğidir. İnanç geleneği ile topluluğun etnik/dilsel kimliği aynı kayıt değildir.
summary.en: A religious tradition strongly associated with Hatay's Arab Alawite community and historically discussed under Nusayri/Alawi terminology. Religious tradition and community identity remain separate entities.
summary.ar: تقليد ديني مرتبط بقوة بالمجتمع العلوي العربي في هاتاي، وقد تناولته المصادر أيضاً بتسميات نصيري وعلوي.

rituals: community-specific practices documented in ethnographic sources
sacred visitation practices where locally documented
sacredFigures: Khidr/Hızır has major documented local significance
other figures require belief-specific source normalization
musicTraditions: Religious sound repertoire remains incompletely researched.
Fann, mawwal, ataba and dabke must not automatically be classified as religious music.
editorialNotes: Terminology is historically and politically sensitive.
Separate insider religious claims from academic historical description.
Avoid 'Necef İlahileri' as a local category; it was not reliably verified.
unresolvedQuestions: Full locally named ritual and sacred-music taxonomy needs community-based field research.

summary.tr: Antakya ve Hatay'daki çok sayıda Müslüman toplulukla tarih boyunca ilişkili geniş inanç geleneğidir. Cami, mevlid, ezan, salâ, cenaze ve bazı tekke pratikleri ayrı yerel ilişki kayıtlarıyla modellenmelidir.
summary.en: Broad Islamic tradition historically associated with multiple Muslim communities in Antakya and Hatay. Mosque life, mawlid, adhan, sala, funerary and some lodge traditions require locality-specific links.
summary.ar: تقليد إسلامي واسع مرتبط تاريخياً بجماعات مسلمة متعددة في أنطاكية وهاتاي.

editorialNotes: Community affiliation must not be inferred solely from mosque proximity.

summary.tr: Antakya Patrikliği geleneğiyle bağlantılı Doğu Ortodoks Hristiyanlık geleneğidir. Hatay'daki Arapça konuşan Rum Ortodoks topluluklarla güçlü ilişkisi vardır; topluluk kimliği belief kaydından ayrı tutulur.
summary.en: Eastern Orthodox Christian tradition associated with the Antiochian patriarchal heritage and strongly connected to Arabic-speaking Greek Orthodox communities in Hatay.
summary.ar: تقليد مسيحي أرثوذكسي شرقي مرتبط بتراث بطريركية أنطاكية وبالجماعات الرومية الأرثوذكسية الناطقة بالعربية في هاتاي.

editorialNotes: St. Pierre is a sacred structure, not this belief entity.
unresolvedQuestions: Structure-by-structure current liturgical use after 2023 requires ongoing updates.

summary.tr: Musa Dağı ve Hatay Ermeni topluluğunun başlıca tarihsel kilise geleneğidir. Vakıflı Surp Asdvadzadzin Kilisesi bu geleneğe bağlı yaşayan kutsal yapı örneğidir.
summary.en: The principal historical church tradition of the Musa Dagh/Hatay Armenian community. Surp Asdvadzadzin Church in Vakıflı is an active sacred structure associated with this tradition.
summary.ar: التقليد الكنسي التاريخي الرئيسي لأرمن جبل موسى وهاتاي، وترتبط به كنيسة سورب أسدفادزادزين في وقفلي.

editorialNotes: Do not use a source's incorrect ecclesiastical classification if it conflicts with institutional church identity.

summary.tr: Hatay'daki Katolik gelenekler için broad belief kaydıdır. Bu araştırma içinde özellikle Antakya Latin Katolik/Kapuçin varlığı doğrulanmıştır; farklı Katolik kilise gelenekleri ayrıca topluluk düzeyinde ayrıştırılmalıdır.
summary.en: Broad belief record for Catholic traditions in Hatay, with the Latin Catholic/Capuchin presence in Antakya specifically documented.
summary.ar: سجل عام للتقاليد الكاثوليكية في هاتاي، مع توثيق خاص للحضور الكاثوليكي اللاتيني/الكبوشي في أنطاكية.

label.en: 19th century documented local institutional presence to present

editorialNotes: St. Pierre is associated with multiple Christian traditions and should not be made exclusive to Catholicism.
unresolvedQuestions: Other Catholic communities/rites in Hatay need denomination-level research.

summary.tr: Hatay'daki tarihsel ve modern Protestan varlığını broad tradition düzeyinde temsil eden geçici belief kaydıdır. Denomination, ibadet yapıları ve yerel topluluklar yeterince araştırılmamıştır.
summary.en: Provisional broad-tradition entity representing historical and modern Protestant presence in Hatay. Denominations, structures and local communities remain insufficiently researched.
summary.ar: سجل مبدئي للحضور البروتستانتي التاريخي والحديث في هاتاي، مع حاجة إلى بحث أكثر تفصيلاً في الطوائف والمباني.

unresolvedQuestions: Denomination, sites, liturgy and modern continuity require dedicated research.

summary.tr: Antakya'nın tarihsel Yahudi varlığıyla bağlantılı broad belief kaydıdır. Antakya Sinagogu bu geleneğe bağlı structure kaydıdır; sinagogun kendisi belief değildir.
summary.en: Broad belief entity associated with Antioch's Jewish heritage. Antakya Synagogue is a related structure, not the belief itself.
summary.ar: كيان ديني عام مرتبط بالتراث اليهودي في أنطاكية، بينما الكنيس مبنى مرتبط بهذا التقليد وليس المعتقد نفسه.

editorialNotes: Do not import generic Sephardic, Syrian Jewish or Mizrahi music into Antakya without local evidence.
unresolvedQuestions: Antakya-specific liturgical music and post-2023 community continuity require research.

summary.tr: Modern mezheplerden biriyle özdeşleştirilemeyecek, erken Hristiyan Antioch'un tarihsel inanç ve kurum bağlamını temsil eder.
summary.en: Historical belief-context entity for early Christianity in Antioch, which must not be collapsed into one modern denomination.
summary.ar: كيان تاريخي يمثل المسيحية المبكرة في أنطاكية دون مساواتها بطائفة حديثة واحدة.

editorialNotes: Apostolic narratives are not automatically verified archaeological facts.
Do not map this entity directly onto modern Greek Orthodox or Catholic belief entities.

title.tr: Antioch ve Daphne'nin Greko-Romen İnanç Gelenekleri
title.en: Greco-Roman Religious Traditions of Antioch and Daphne
title.ar: التقاليد الدينية اليونانية الرومانية في أنطاكية ودافني

summary.tr: Helenistik ve Roma Antioch/Daphne'sindeki çoktanrılı kültler ve mitolojik anlatılar için historical belief kaydıdır. Apollon-Daphne anlatısı bu bağlamda mythologicalNarrative olarak sınıflandırılır.
summary.en: Historical belief entity for the polytheistic cults and mythological traditions of Hellenistic and Roman Antioch/Daphne.
summary.ar: كيان تاريخي للتقاليد الدينية المتعددة الآلهة في أنطاكية ودافني خلال العهدين الهلنستي والروماني.

associatedStructures: Daphne archaeological ensemble; individual temples require archaeological verification
editorialNotes: Mythological narratives must remain mythologicalNarrative, not verifiedHistorical.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact identification of individual cult sites requires archaeological data.

title.en: Local Sacred Visitation Traditions of Hatay
title.ar: تقاليد الزيارات والمقامات المحلية في هاتاي

summary.tr: Hatay'da türbe, makam ve ziyaret alanlarının farklı topluluklar tarafından dua, adak, şifa veya yerel kutsallık bağlamında ziyaret edilmesini temsil eden cross-tradition practice entity'sidir. Tek başına bağımsız bir din değildir.
summary.en: Cross-tradition practice entity for visits to shrines and sacred sites in Hatay for prayer, vows, healing and local sacred traditions. It is not a standalone religion.
summary.ar: كيان للممارسات المحلية المرتبطة بزيارة المقامات والأماكن المقدسة للنذر والدعاء والشفاء، ولا يمثل ديناً مستقلاً.

editorialNotes: beliefType: crossTraditionPractice
A sacred-site practice may be shared; do not assign exclusivity without evidence.
unresolvedQuestions: Full sacred-site network in Samandağ and Defne remains a priority research gap.

summary.tr: Geç Antik ve Ortaçağ Antioch'un Süryanice Hristiyan çevreleri için broad historical belief entity'sidir. Modern Hatay'daki denomination ve topluluk sürekliliği ayrıca araştırılmalıdır.
summary.en: Broad historical belief entity for Syriac Christian traditions in late-antique and medieval Antioch. Modern denominational continuity in Hatay needs separate research.
summary.ar: كيان تاريخي للتقاليد المسيحية السريانية في أنطاكية، مع حاجة إلى بحث مستقل حول الاستمرارية الحديثة في هاتاي.

label.en: late antique / medieval; modern continuity unresolved

editorialNotes: Do not infer modern denomination from ancient Antiochene terminology.
unresolvedQuestions: Which Syriac church traditions maintained documented local continuity into the modern period?

title.en: Sufi and Lodge Traditions of Antakya
title.ar: التقاليد الصوفية وتقاليد التكايا في أنطاكية

summary.tr: Osmanlı Antakya'sındaki tekke, zaviye ve Mevlevilik bağlantılarının broad practice/inanç bağlamını temsil eden geçici kayıttır. DR-7'de Antakya Mevlevihanesi ve tekke musikisi araştırılmış, ancak tam yapı ve tarikat ağı henüz normalize edilmemiştir.
summary.en: Provisional broad record for Sufi lodge and Mevlevi-related traditions in Ottoman Antakya. Religious-music research identified the subject, but the complete institutional network has not yet been normalized.
summary.ar: سجل مبدئي للتقاليد الصوفية والتكايا والارتباط المولوي في أنطاكية العثمانية، مع حاجة إلى استكمال شبكة المؤسسات والمواقع.

associatedCommunities: Muslim communities; specific mapping NOT YET RESEARCHED
associatedStructures: Antakya Mevlevihanesi: structure record NOT YET NORMALIZED
editorialNotes: Do not treat all Sunni religious music as Sufi music.
unresolvedQuestions: Tekke, zaviye, order affiliation and surviving structures require Vakıf/archival research.

summary.tr: Modern Antakya ile tarihsel Antioch aynı uzun süreli kentsel geleneğin ad katmanlarıdır; ancak modern idari yerleşim ile antik kentin arkeolojik fiziksel yayılımı aynı mekânsal birim olarak değerlendirilmemelidir.
summary.en: Modern Antakya and historical Antioch belong to the same long urban naming tradition, but the modern administrative settlement and the physical archaeological footprint of ancient Antioch should not be treated as spatially identical.
summary.ar: تمثل أنطاكية الحديثة وAntioch التاريخية طبقات اسمية لمدينة ذات استمرارية طويلة، مع ضرورة الفصل بين المدينة الحديثة والنطاق الأثري للمدينة القديمة.

etymology.en: Historical name continuity is strong; detailed linguistic derivation is retained for source-level review.

editorialNotes: Historical name usage must remain period-sensitive.
Ancient Antioch archaeological area is separately represented as place-0002.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact polygon relationship between the ancient metropolis and modern urban boundaries remains GIS work.

summary.tr: Antik Antioch'un Asi, dağ yamaçları ve çevredeki arkeolojik izlerle tanımlanan fiziksel kentsel yayılımını temsil eden place kaydıdır.
summary.en: Place entity representing the physical archaeological footprint of ancient Antioch, distinct from the modern administrative city.
summary.ar: كيان مكاني يمثل الامتداد الأثري لمدينة أنطاكية القديمة بصورة منفصلة عن المدينة الإدارية الحديثة.

etymology.en: Archaeological place entity used to distinguish the ancient urban footprint from modern Antakya.
